snippet.title: Streets of Rage 4 - Battle Mode & Release Date
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/985890/Streets_of_Rage_4/  
PS4 USA: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UP1482-CUSA16237_00-00STREETSOFRAGE4
Nintendo eShop: https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/streets-of-rage-4-switch/ 
PS4 EU: https://store.playstation.com/en-gb/product/EP1470-CUSA16221_00-00STREETSOFRAGE4
GOG: https://www.gog.com/game/streets_of_rage_4
Humble Bundle: https://fr.humblebundle.com/store/streets-of-rage-4
Xbox One: https://www.microsoft.com/en-gb/p/streets-of-rage-4/9n7h54kncb9n?activetab=pivot:overviewtab

The wait is over! Streets of Rage 4 is now available on PC, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, Xbox One for $24,99!

Give a first look at Streets of Rage 4’s Battle Mode, a legacy experience returning from Streets of Rage 2 and 3. This feud-settling battleground is bound to help rivals recognize who truly is Wood Oak City’s finest alley-clearing ruffian, as well as settle grudges spurred by accidental friendly strikes during multiplayer sessions. 

To keep up with all things Streets of Rage 4, be sure to wishlist the game on Steam (https://store.steampowered.com/app/985890/Streets_of_Rage_4/), head to www.streets4rage.com, check out www.facebook.com/StreetsofRage4, pummel @Dotemu, @Lizardcube, and @Guard_Crush’s follow buttons on Twitter, and join us on Discord: https://discord.gg/DvVq4yz.
